overview: The entity action packet carries sprint, crouch, leave-bed, horse jump and inventory-open actions. Sprint and sneak state is the server-side contract anticheats validate: omni-sprint modules forge the sprint action while ignoring hunger and blindness, and toggle spam abuses the state machine. The corpus shows adapters that forward the action (NCP EntityActionAdapter), state checks that validate sprint against food and potions (Grim SprintA, Truthful SprintA), and direction checks on the move stream (Azure OmniSprint).

checks.name: SprintA (Grim)
checks.purpose: Post-prediction sprint state check: sprinting with a food level at or below 6 is invalid.
checks.how_it_works: A PostPredictionListener running after the movement simulation. If the prediction was not checked, the player can fly, or the player rides a camel, the check returns (both are legitimate sprint cases). Otherwise, when food is at or below 6 and the client's sprinting flag (set from the entity action packet) is true, it flags with the food level in the verbose; when the flag is false it rewards the balance.
checks.detects: Omni-sprint and auto-sprint modules that sprint with no hunger, and clients that forge the sprint action state.
checks.variations: Grim's SprintB through SprintG cover sprint direction, 1.9+ sprint and vehicle cases; the entity action packet itself is parsed in PacketEntityAction which feeds player.isSprinting.

checks.name: OmniSprint (Azure)
checks.purpose: Classic omni-sprint detection: diagonal movement direction must agree with the client yaw.
checks.how_it_works: On PlayerMoveEvent with the server-side sprint flag active (set from the entity action packet), it computes deltaX/deltaZ from the movement and the absolute yaw quadrant. Movement diagonally in a direction that contradicts the yaw quadrant is the omni-sprint signature and raises an immediate violation with a 60 second cooldown.
checks.detects: Omni-sprint cheats that move diagonally while facing straight, and sprint direction spoofing.
checks.variations: Truthful SprintA flags the same behavior via blindness and hunger state; FlopAC WTapA/B/C and SprintA/B cover sprint-wtap and sprint-state on the packet stream.

checks.name: EntityActionAdapter (NoCheatPlus)
checks.purpose: The ProtocolLib bridge for the entity action packet, feeding NCP's net toggle-frequency check.
checks.how_it_works: A BaseAdapter registered at LOW priority for ENTITY_ACTION. It resolves player data safely, records the action timestamp into the player action frequency buffer, refreshes the last-packet time, and runs the ToggleFrequency check that limits how often sprint and sneak can be toggled. A cancel decision requests a setback through the player data.
checks.detects: Sprint and sneak toggle spam, action-frequency abuse, and clients that flood entity actions to desync server state.
checks.variations: Frequency's WrappedPlayInEntityAction feeds BadPacketsC/G and InvalidD/E; CheaterDeleter's PlayerInteractEntity mixin covers the modern 1.19+ equivalent on the same action domain.

checks.name: SprintA (Truthful)
checks.purpose: Sprint state validity check on the movement stream: sprinting is illegal with blindness or with food at or below 6.
checks.how_it_works: Handles relative-move wrappers on position updates. If the player is not sprinting (sprint state set from the entity action packet) the buffer decays. When sprinting and not allowed to fly, blindness adds 2.0 to the buffer (flag at 4.0) and food at or below 6 adds 1.0 (flag at 5.0), with a decaying buffer that resets on quit.
checks.detects: Omni-sprint with blindness, hunger-ignoring sprint modules, and sprint state desync.
checks.variations: SprintB in the same package adds direction validation; Photon's BetterSprint sentinel module and FlopAC SprintA cover the same ground on other bases.
